name: Asakana
long_description:
Founded by an ex-seafood distributor and ex-McKinsey, and an 8-year Google AI engineer who built Gemini's web agents.
Restaurants send orders to food distributors by email, text, and WeChat. Someone at the distributor retypes them into the ERP. Asakana does that entry instead. Live at our first customer, saving 95% of order entry time per order. Its $4B parent group is now rolling Asakana out across its companies. cMRR growing 41% WoW
one_liner: Back-office automation for food distributors, no behavior change
